method.hardware: c8g.metal-24xl (96 Graviton4 cores), one server host and three client hosts per pod, same AZ and placement group, 0.10 ms client-server round trip
method.build: GCC 11.5, -O3 -flto, jemalloc, identical flags for both builds
method.pinning: main thread core 1, IO thread i on core i+1, superset poller core 65, replication sender core 66, background threads 67-79, NIC IRQs 80-95, irqbalance off
method.client: memtier_benchmark 2.5.2 on cores 16-95 of each client host; 9,600 connections at P1, 2,304 at P16, 960 at P64
method.run: 3 reps per build, builds alternating, 10 s measurement window after warm-up; values are medians of the 3 reps
method.verdict: win/regress when the median ratio is beyond 5% and the two builds' rep ranges do not overlap, otherwise tie; high variance = CV over 5% on either build
notes: io-threads equals write lanes in superset (no separate setting).
Superset IO threads and poller busy-poll, so they read ~100% CPU when idle; ops per CPU-second is comparable only at io-threads 8 or fewer.
NIC: a cell flagged NIC had the ENA bandwidth/pps allowance counters rise during the window, so its numbers are lower bounds on server capacity.
p100 includes connection setup and reaches ~15 s at io-threads 1 on both builds; use p99.9.
Earlier GET runs that all missed (prefill key-name mismatch) were discarded and rerun.

regressions.title: MSET of 10 keys
regressions.detail: 0.43-0.47x at io-threads 8 and 32, every pipeline depth; no gain from IO threads

regressions.title: 80/20 mix cliff at P16
regressions.detail: superset 11.4M at io-threads 16 falls to ~5.0M at 32 and 64 (still ~1.9x upstream); same cap in every tier-3 80/20 P16 io-threads 32 cell; poller 100% busy

regressions.title: maxmemory eviction
regressions.detail: 0.80-0.85x at P16, 0.90x at P1 io-threads 8; p99 about 2x upstream

regressions.title: Replica disconnect on SET-only
regressions.detail: superset replica link drops 1-3 s into every rep at io-threads 8+; 50/50 mix stays in sync

regressions.title: Single-thread overhead
regressions.detail: 3-7% slower at io-threads 1 across every command
